notes: The extra Telegram card came from a boot-time factory that re-minted a row for every merge to bury; the factory is gone, and the cards settle to one while keeping token, pairing, and history.
Sending to Telegram from the Ask panel works now: the server resolves your paired chat itself, so the tab no longer depends on a chat id the app never knew.
Updates stop asking macOS for permission to read other apps' data; those checks now run only on the screens that manage tool connections, where the question makes sense.
Overnight "not running" alerts wait for a real outage: three failed checks in a row and a settled wake, so a sleeping Mac no longer pages you at every stir.
The update screen now tells the truth about duration: Docker updates rebuild on your machine and can take ten minutes or more, with the database backup always running first.
The MCP log's preload notice now says plainly that it is normal while the API restarts during an update.
